recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Blueberries
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and stir in the whey protein isolate until smooth.
Top with chopped walnuts, pumpkin seeds and blueberries.
Dust with ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Chicken, Chickpea and Feta Salad
instructions: Toss romaine, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion and chickpeas in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and oregano for the dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Top with sliced grilled chicken and crumbled feta before serving.

recipe.name: Grilled Carne Asada Tacos with Charred Elote and Frijoles
instructions: Marinate flank steak with lime juice, garlic, cumin, chili powder and half the cilantro for 20 minutes.
Grill steak over high heat 3-4 minutes per side until charred and medium-rare; rest, then slice thinly against the grain.
Toss grilled corn kernels with a little olive oil and salt; warm black beans with diced onion.
Char corn tortillas directly over the grill flame until lightly blistered.
Fill tortillas with sliced steak, top with cotija, remaining cilantro and white onion.
Serve tacos alongside the grilled corn and black beans.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Peppered Mackerel with Lemon and Dill
instructions: Flake the smoked mackerel fillet onto a plate, removing any bones.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.
Sprinkle with fresh chopped dill and cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature.

recipe.name: Tandoori-Style Roast Chicken Leg with Roasted Cauliflower and Spinach
instructions: In a bowl, mix yogurt, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, turmeric, lemon juice and salt to form a tandoori marinade.
Coat the chicken leg thoroughly with the marinade and let sit at least 30 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Preheat oven to 220°C. Place marinated chicken leg on a roasting tray and roast for 30-35 minutes until golden and cooked through, turning once.
Toss cauliflower florets with half the ghee and a pinch of salt; roast alongside the chicken for the last 20 minutes, until charred at the edges.
In the final few minutes, wilt the baby spinach in a pan with the remaining ghee until just softened.
Plate the roasted chicken leg with cauliflower and spinach, spooning over any pan juices.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky White Bean & Turkey Bacon Bake with Egg
instructions: Heat olive oil in a small skillet, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add smoked paprika and tomato passata, simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in white beans, season with black pepper, and heat through.
Push beans to one side, crack egg into the pan, cover and cook until white is set.
In a separate pan, crisp the turkey bacon until browned.
Plate the beans and egg, top with crumbled turkey bacon and parsley.

recipe.name: Thai Massaman-Style Braised Beef Cheek with Potatoes
instructions: Sear beef cheek cubes in a dry pot until browned on all sides, then remove.
In the same pot, fry massaman curry paste with a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Return beef to the pot, add remaining coconut milk, shallot, bay leaves and cinnamon stick.
Add fish sauce, tamarind paste and palm sugar, stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and braise on low heat for 2 hours until beef is tender.
Add potato cubes in the last 30 minutes of braising, simmering until soft.
Rest the braise off heat for 15 minutes to let flavors meld before serving.
Garnish with crushed roasted peanuts and fresh coriander leaves.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Spinach and Feta Egg White Scramble with Whole Egg
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Add spinach and wilt for 1-2 minutes.
Whisk egg white and whole egg together, season with salt and pepper, and pour into the skillet.
Cook gently, stirring occasionally, until eggs are just set.
Crumble feta over the top, fold in gently, and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Japanese Chicken and Vegetable Curry with Steamed Rice

ingredients.name: Curry roux paste (flour, curry powder, butter blend)

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant and softened.
Add chicken pieces and sear until lightly browned on all sides.
Add carrot and potato, then pour in chicken stock and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Reduce heat, break curry roux paste into the pot, and stir until fully dissolved and sauce thickens.
Stir in soy sauce and simmer uncovered for 3-4 minutes to meld flavors.
Serve the curry over steamed white rice and garnish with sliced scallion.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Vanilla Almond Protein Shake
instructions: Add coconut milk, water, almond butter, protein powder, vanilla extract and cinnamon to a blender.
Add ice cubes and blend on high for 45-60 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Pour into a large glass and drink immediately.

recipe.name: Greek One-Pan Lemon Feta Shrimp with Zucchini and Olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (fan 200°C).
On a large sheet pan, toss zucchini and cherry tomatoes with half the olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Roast for 10 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Remove pan, push vegetables to the sides, and add shrimp in a single layer in the center. Drizzle shrimp with remaining olive oil and lemon juice.
Scatter kalamata olives and crumbled feta over the entire tray.
Return to oven and roast for a further 8-10 minutes until shrimp are pink and just cooked through.
Remove from oven, sprinkle with fresh dill, and serve immediately straight from the pan.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Blueberries
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts, pumpkin seeds and chia seeds.
Scatter fresh blueberries over the top and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi-Style Stir Fry with Vegetables
instructions: Combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger, grated pear and half the sesame oil; marinate the beef slices for 15 minutes.
Heat a wok over high heat with remaining sesame oil until smoking.
Stir-fry the marinated beef in batches for 1-2 minutes until just seared; remove and set aside.
Add cabbage, carrot and shiitake mushrooms to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the wok, add gochujang and spring onion, and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve hot over cooked rice, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Mackerel with Soft Scrambled Eggs and Chives
instructions: Warm the smoked mackerel fillet gently, either in a low oven or a dry pan, until heated through.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over low heat, add beaten eggs and stir slowly for soft, creamy curds.
Season eggs with black pepper and fold in chopped chives just before removing from heat.
Slice cucumber and plate alongside the eggs and mackerel.
Serve immediately while warm.

recipe.name: Grilled Lamb Chops with Zhoug, Charred Peppers and Tahini Sauce
instructions: Pat lamb chops dry, rub with salt, cumin and a little olive oil, and let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Blend parsley, cilantro, garlic, a pinch of salt, and a splash of olive oil into a rough zhoug-style green sauce.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a little water until smooth and pourable to make the tahini sauce.
Heat a grill or heavy skillet over high heat, sear lamb chops 3-4 minutes per side until charred outside and pink inside, then rest.
Toss bell pepper and zucchini slices with remaining olive oil, grill or char in the same pan until softened with grill marks.
Plate lamb chops with charred vegetables, drizzle tahini sauce over vegetables and spoon zhoug over the lamb.
